normandy.name: 9th Infantry Regiment ‘Manchus’ — Normandy Campaign
normandy.description: The 9th Infantry Regiment campaign in Normandy, 8 June–16 August 1944. Mission objectives, map sizes, enemy posture, and attachments are transcribed from the Normandy mission book; terrain cards are drawn from the Normandy deck.

company_roster.source: Normandy Campaign Unit Guide and Company TO&E in documentation/fof/README.md

weapons_platoon.selection_rule: Choose the section or the three individual teams per campaign special rule 2.

campaign_rules.runners: No runners are available at mission start; create them from existing units if needed.
campaign_rules.replacements: After each mission, receive up to 6 Green replacement steps, plus any returning veteran steps.
campaign_rules.casualty_evacuation: Place a CCP Tactical Control anywhere on the map before each mission, or establish one during play.
campaign_rules.communications: SCR536 CO TAC radios may be replaced by EE8 field phones in offensive missions; four phone-line assets are available when selected. Phones are not available for combat patrols.
campaign_rules.mortar_selection: For each mission choose either the 3-step 60mm Mortar Section or the three separate 1-step Mortar Teams.
campaign_rules.german_squads: Use the mission-designated Grenadier or Fallschirmjäger groups; track MG42 ammunition where applicable.
campaign_rules.squad_infiltration: Resolve German Squad Infiltration Attempts using two Action cards, adjusted for experience.
campaign_rules.german_at_units: Use campaign-specific German AT activation rules; Panzerfausts target vehicles only.
campaign_rules.terrain_cover: For Village, Farm, Cemetery, and Church cover, determine the cover type from the campaign table.
campaign_rules.mortar_restriction: Mortar Teams and Sections may not fire from Woods terrain.
campaign_rules.engineers: Where assigned, engineers may use the campaign mine-detection and path-clearing procedures.
